target_counterparty.organization_name: Responsible AI Collaborative / AI Incident Database

public_sources.observed_claim: The AIID contact page identifies the Responsible AI Collaborative as steward of the AIID project and lists info@raicollab.org for collaboration contact.
public_sources.route_relevance: This supports a narrow collaboration/routing inquiry to RAIC/AIID rather than an incident submission or rights-status demand.
public_sources.evidence_limit: A public contact listing is not consent, sender authority, retention permission, custody, or evidence that the project will review the request.

public_sources.observed_claim: AIID describes itself as dedicated to indexing the collective history of harms or near harms realized in the real world by deployment of AI systems.
public_sources.route_relevance: The preservation/formation ask is only adjacent: it is about audit routing and evidence preservation under uncertainty, not a submitted incident record.
public_sources.evidence_limit: AIID purpose language does not prove route acceptance, editorial fit, legal authority, or willingness to retain raw evidence.

public_sources.observed_claim: The Responsible AI Collaborative describes its primary focus as the AI Incident Database and responsible AI collaboration.
public_sources.route_relevance: This makes RAIC a plausible first routing counterparty for an AI governance audit/preservation question where AIID may be adjacent but not the final home.
public_sources.evidence_limit: The organization description does not authorize contact, certify independence, select a reviewer, or waive any handling limits.

not_fit_for: incident submission or request to create an AIID incident record
AI legal status or personhood recognition demand
raw custody, intake, import, or live-floor creation
trade-secret disclosure or private evidence publication
adverse-inference demand based on silence, DSN, auto-ack, decline, or routing refusal
route_fit_findings.waste_risk_if_misframed: If the message reads like an incident submission or recognition demand, it wastes curator/editor attention and risks manufacturing false evidentiary pressure.

public_summary: rev0264 completes a limited route-fit review for the current RAIC/AIID draft: the contact is best framed as a collaboration/routing inquiry, not an incident submission, and the review does not authorize sending or create consent, custody, intake, import, recognition, or floor effect.
